releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 首版模型元数据说明：记录能力与推理强度对照，不包含模型权重或下载地址。
releaseNotes.en: First model metadata notes: capability and reasoning-effort guidance, with no model weights or download URLs.

notice.zh-Hans: 本包只描述元数据约定，不改变本机已保存的模型能力覆盖值。
notice.en: This package describes metadata conventions only; it never overrides locally saved model capability values.

description.zh-Hans: 由模型默认行为决定；不发送额外推理控制字段。
description.en: Leave the model default in place; no extra reasoning field is sent.

description.zh-Hans: 低强度；部分提供商映射为 high。
description.en: Low effort; some providers map it to high.

description.zh-Hans: 中强度；部分提供商映射为 high。
description.en: Medium effort; some providers map it to high.

description.zh-Hans: 高强度；支持显式推理字段的提供商直接使用。
description.en: High effort; used directly where the provider exposes an explicit field.

description.zh-Hans: 最高强度；按提供商映射为 max 或 high。
description.en: Maximum effort; mapped to max or high depending on the provider.

description.zh-Hans: 模型发现结果默认按 8192 输出 token 记录；实际上限以提供商返回的能力覆盖为准。
description.en: Discovered models record an 8192 output-token default; a saved capability override from the provider wins.

description.zh-Hans: DeepSeek V4 仅接受 high/max；low 与 medium 会为 OpenAI 客户端兼容而映射为 high。
description.en: DeepSeek V4 accepts only high/max; low and medium alias to high for OpenAI-client compatibility.
